title: Short: Why you should never ignore an error email (Knight Capital)

lines.text: Why you should never ignore an error email. One cost four hundred sixty million dollars.
In twenty twelve, Knight Capital was a giant of US stock trading.
But one of its eight servers missed a software update.
Before the market opened, it sent ninety-seven warning emails. Nobody acted.
Then that server fired four million orders in forty-five minutes.
Knight's stock crashed over seventy percent, and it needed a rescue.
Would you have read those emails?
